# DIARY OF A DEFECTOR [italic]Kept on a borrowed terminal, in a language that is not mine, by a man using a name that is not his.[/italic]
I was a soldier of the Union of Progressive Peoples. Naval Infantry, conscript, rifleman, number withheld. Now I mend pipes on a frontier colony for a wage in a currency I still count twice. I will not say which colony. I will not say which ship. If you work it out, keep it to yourself.
I write here because paper can be found under a mattress, and a man who is found with paper is a man who is found. This place is not safe either. Nothing is. But at three in the morning it is the furthest from the Union I can reach.
[color=#C9442C][bold]IF YOU ARE FROM THE MINISTRY: I AM ALREADY GONE.[/bold][/color]
## THE ENTRIES - [netlink="I. Ration Cards" link="defector.deep/union"] - how we lived, and why nobody leaves. - [netlink="II. The Water Tank" link="defector.deep/desertion"] - the night I went over the side. - [netlink="III. Footsteps" link="defector.deep/found"] - what it is to be hunted by patient people.
## RULES OF THIS PAGE - Do not try to meet me. I will not come, and the man who comes in my place will not be a friend. - Do not say my old name in a bar. Three people on this rock know it, and I only trust one of them. - Do not send me money. Money leaves a trail. So do favours.
[color=#5A5040]-- entries are written in the pump room. the fans are loud. forgive the spelling. --[/color]
If the entries stop, I did not get bored. Look for me on [netlink="the missing list" link="missing.deep"]. If a marshal starts asking about new faces, [netlink="someone keeps count" link="marshalwatch.deep"].
